«Romance at short notice was her special: “Romance at short notice was her speciality” — she is good at making up stories on the spot, and the story about the dogs is invented too.
Віра каже, що чоловік і брати тітки заги: Vera says that her aunt’s husband and brothers died in the bog and that her aunt still waits for them by the window.
Повіривши Вірі, він приймає живих мислив: Because he believes Vera, he thinks the living hunters are ghosts.
Фремтон лікує нерви, тож лікарі приписал: Framton is having his nerves treated, so the doctors told him to rest.
Чоловік і брати повертаються живими — Ві: The husband and brothers come back alive — Vera made it all up.
